notes.scope: 24 Lost Docks fishing shop tools: 8 rods, 8 bobbers, and 8 baits. Excludes the Fishing Key, Lure I-IV, lassos, wolf Bone bait, totems, potions, chests, food-coded items, and the Fishing Luck gamepass.
notes.imagePolicy: Game.Guide isolated item PNGs for all 8 rods and 7/8 baits. Chicken Bait has no Game.Guide icon. All 8 bobbers have no isolated source art; Fandom/BloxInformer/shop screenshots were rejected.

item.name: Basic Rod
item.effect: Stronger rods improve the chance of reeling in rarer pets.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Buy this first so you can fish Lost Docks ponds at all.
item.cardSummary: Cheapest Chase rod and the entry tool for Lost Docks fishing.

item.name: Advanced Rod
item.effect: Stronger rods improve the chance of reeling in rarer pets.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: The first upgrade after Basic Rod when early ponds start feeling slow.
item.cardSummary: Rare Chase rod that sits one step above the starter rod.

item.name: Bamboo Rod
item.effect: Stronger rods improve the chance of reeling in rarer pets.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Use as the mid-Chase rod before spending millions on Spiked Rod.
item.cardSummary: Epic Chase rod in the middle of the Lost Docks shop ladder.

item.name: Spiked Rod
item.effect: Stronger rods improve the chance of reeling in rarer pets.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Buy when Epic fishing targets matter more than saving for Golden Rod.
item.cardSummary: Second Epic Chase rod and the first million-coin fishing upgrade.

item.name: Golden Rod
item.effect: Stronger rods improve the chance of reeling in rarer pets.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Hold this until Shark Rod is realistic rather than staying on Spiked Rod.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Chase rod that bridges the expensive late shop upgrades.

item.name: Shark Rod
item.effect: Stronger rods improve the chance of reeling in rarer pets.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Chase-shop ceiling before unlocking Valerian's Dragon and Kraken rods.
item.cardSummary: Mythical Chase rod and the strongest rod sold before the underground shop.

item.name: Dragon Rod
item.effect: Listed as a very powerful fishing rod.
item.source: Buy from Valerian in the Lost Docks underground shop after using the Fishing Key
item.bestUse: Buy after Shark Rod if Kraken Rod is still out of reach.
item.cardSummary: Boss-tier Valerian rod that sits just under the strongest listed fishing rod.

item.name: Kraken Rod
item.effect: Listed as the most powerful fishing rod.
item.source: Buy from Valerian in the Lost Docks underground shop after using the Fishing Key
item.bestUse: Pair with Starlight Bobber and Bacon Bait when chasing the rarest water pets.
item.cardSummary: Divine Valerian rod and the strongest fishing rod on the Lost Docks shop lists.

item.name: Basic Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Get from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Equip only until you can afford Lime or Mint Bobber.
item.cardSummary: Free starter bobber from Chase with no extra listed bonus.

item.name: Lime Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: First paid bobber when you want a mutation helper without waiting for Mint.
item.cardSummary: Rare Chase bobber and the cheapest paid mutation helper.

item.name: Mint Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: A cheap luck helper while saving for Stardust or Royal Bobber.
item.cardSummary: Second Rare Chase bobber and a low-cost step above Lime.

item.name: Stardust Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Buy when mutated water pets matter more than staying on Mint Bobber.
item.cardSummary: Epic Chase bobber in the middle of the Lost Docks bobber ladder.

item.name: Royal Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Use as the late mid-game bobber before Chomber Bobber.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Chase bobber that sits below the million-plus late upgrades.

item.name: Chomber Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Buy when you can skip Royal Bobber and start pushing toward Kraken Bobber.
item.cardSummary: Mythical Chase bobber on the expensive late shop ladder.

item.name: Kraken Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Use until Starlight Bobber is affordable for divine fishing routes.
item.cardSummary: Godly Chase bobber and the last stop before Starlight.

item.name: Starlight Bobber
item.effect: Bobbers are described as increasing the chance of catching mutated animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Equip with Kraken Rod and Bacon Bait for the strongest listed fishing setup.
item.cardSummary: Divine Chase bobber and the highest bobber on the Lost Docks shop list.

item.name: Worm Bait
item.effect: Baits increase fishing luck to attract rarer animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Spend on early Lost Docks fishing instead of skipping bait entirely.
item.cardSummary: Common Chase bait and the cheapest luck spend for fishing.

item.name: Shrimp Bait
item.effect: Baits increase fishing luck to attract rarer animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: A cheap Rare bait when Worm Bait is not in stock.
item.cardSummary: Rare Chase bait that sits just above Worm Bait.

item.name: Apple Bait
item.effect: Baits increase fishing luck to attract rarer animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Use when you want a stronger Rare bait without jumping to Chicken Bait.
item.cardSummary: Second Rare Chase bait and a mid-early luck option.

item.name: Chicken Bait
item.effect: Baits increase fishing luck to attract rarer animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Buy for Epic fishing sessions before spending millions on Sardine or Bug Bait.
item.cardSummary: Epic Chase bait in the middle of the Lost Docks bait ladder.

item.name: Sardine Bait
item.effect: Baits increase fishing luck to attract rarer animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop
item.bestUse: Save for Legendary fishing instead of burning it on common water pets.
item.cardSummary: Legendary Chase bait and the first million-coin luck item.

item.name: Bug Bait
item.effect: Baits increase fishing luck to attract rarer animals.
item.source: Buy from Chase at the Lost Docks Shop. Also listed on the Fishing Spin Wheel.
item.bestUse: Chase-shop bait ceiling before unlocking Valerian Squid and Bacon Bait.
item.cardSummary: Mythical Chase bait and the strongest bait sold before the underground shop.

item.name: Squid Bait
item.effect: Provides x7.5 luck for one catch.
item.source: Buy from Valerian in the Lost Docks underground shop after using the Fishing Key
item.bestUse: Spend on a catch you already plan to keep rather than on filler water pets.
item.cardSummary: Godly Valerian bait with a listed x7.5 luck bonus for a single catch.

item.name: Bacon Bait
item.effect: Provides x10 luck for one catch.
item.source: Buy from Valerian in the Lost Docks underground shop after using the Fishing Key
item.bestUse: Use with Kraken Rod and Starlight Bobber when hunting the rarest water pets.
item.cardSummary: Divine Valerian bait with a listed x10 luck bonus for a single catch.
